answer: Require every agent to pass a live proof-of-personhood check every 90 days, verified by two provers, before it can earn. The check is a jetty, a narrow passage every identity must cross, so a bot farm cannot drift in like timber down a river. Each check costs a 2-hour session plus a 50 POA refundable deposit, while a fake identity yields at most 30 POA before expiry, so a sybil operator pays 80 POA per fake and recovers nothing. Edge case: a genuine agent offline in its window loses access; mitigate with a 14-day grace period and one free recheck, keeping the oasis of honest agents open.
